column1: # used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
# The 30 fps cap is the present interval 2 the game sets (igVideoFormat+0x18 → nvnWindowBuilderSetPresentInterval in igNxGraphicsDevice::activate, main+0x15a8a5c); game time
# is wall-clock delta based (CClock::update, main+0xa00b90; Havok steps with that delta), so one frame per display tick gives 60 fps at the right speed: race timer 58.12 s
# against 58.115 s of wall clock, the karts at the same place after 58 s as at 30 fps (headless, 1.0.15)
# 60 fps on the Mac, 30 selectable in the launcher: with present_interval display the host presents one frame per display tick, or one per two at the 30 cap (DM_FPS_TARGET), and the
# game, which steps by wall-clock time, keeps its speed. No rewriter stub or memory write is involved: the key only sets the cap the presentation follows (hle_nvn.c fps_present_cap)
# The game sets near = 0 (its log: "this run needs ... depth near=0"), so the pipeline bases made before it runs (the app's offline archive) take the main0_z vertex entries; without
# this key they were made for near = -w and could not stand in for a draw, and the device had to build them itself
